reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is exposing local Kimi WebBridge browser navigation, interaction, inspection, capture, upload, and export tools to agents.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Kimi WebBridge 浏览器能力接入 DeepSeek Harness，为智能体提供网页导航、交互、页面检查、截图、文件上传和 PDF 保存工具。
summaries.en: Connects the local Kimi WebBridge browser to DeepSeek Harness, giving agents tools for web navigation, interaction, page inspection, screenshots, file uploads, and PDF export.

capabilities: Control browser tabs using an existing authenticated browser session
Navigate pages and interact with elements and form fields
Execute JavaScript and exposed Chrome DevTools Protocol commands in pages
Capture screenshots and inspect network requests
Upload local files and save pages as PDFs
Start a local browser bridge daemon
